name: babav
title: BABAV
description: Find people, add leads, approve replies and posts, answer in your brand voice, watch hot leads and book meetings — your BABAV brand, one keystroke away.
author: ty_blacke

commands.name: quick-reply
commands.title: Quick Reply
commands.subtitle: Write a reply in your brand voice and copy it
commands.description: Write a reply in your brand voice and copy it to the clipboard.

commands.name: find-person
commands.title: Find Person
commands.subtitle: Search your people and leads; call, text, email
commands.description: Search your people and leads; see their last message; call, text, email or open them in BABAV.

commands.name: approve-queue
commands.title: Approve Queue
commands.subtitle: Approve replies, drafts and posts waiting for you
commands.description: Approve replies, drafts and posts waiting for you. Enter approves, Cmd+Backspace rejects.

commands.name: add-lead
commands.title: Add Lead
commands.subtitle: Save a lead from the selected text or clipboard
commands.description: Save a lead from the selected text or your clipboard.

commands.name: book-meeting
commands.title: Book a Meeting
commands.subtitle: Copy your booking link, or book someone in
commands.description: Copy your booking link, or pick an open time and book someone in.

commands.name: switch-brand
commands.title: Switch Brand
commands.subtitle: Choose which brand the commands act on
commands.description: Choose which of your brands the other commands act on.

commands.name: menu-bar
commands.title: BABAV Menu Bar
commands.subtitle: Hot leads, missed calls and approvals in the menu bar
commands.description: Hot leads, missed calls and items waiting for approval, in the menu bar (Mac only).

preferences.name: connectionKey
preferences.title: Connection Key
preferences.description: Optional. Your BABAV Connection Key (starts with bvk_), from BABAV › Settings › Extensions & apps. You can also paste it on the Connect screen any command shows. The same key BABAV Finder and BABAV Compose use.

preferences.name: apiBase
preferences.title: API Base URL
preferences.description: Leave as is unless BABAV support tells you otherwise.

scripts.publish: echo 'Ty publishes by hand: npx @raycast/api@latest publish' && exit 1
